name: EPIC 201725474
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 6.6 solar radii and 1.00 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201725474 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.598657 (16th-84th percentiles 6.362737-6.850564), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201725474 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.000785 (16th-84th percentiles 0.91065-1.102767), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201725474: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4785.8745 +/- 57 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201725474 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2244.199219 (16th-84th percentiles 2176.09375-2313.691406), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = -0.01 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,244 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.00 solar masses and 6.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,786 K at its surface.
